name: Chaturbate
summary: The world's largest freemium live cam network: thousands of rooms live around the clock, open public tipping, and deep interactive toy/bot support.
ranking_rationale: Unmatched live broadcaster liquidity across every demographic and kink, backed by a vibrant open tip-bot and Lovense ecosystem—despite a utilitarian layout.

pricing.free_tier: Public live rooms and chat are open to watch without buying tokens
pricing.notes: Token bundles vary by package size and payment method; public browsing requires no payment. Check official checkout.

pros: Largest live room selection online at any hour across all categories
Public tip-driven shows let you watch without mandatory private fees
Massive ecosystem of tip games, bots, and Bluetooth toy sync
Zero paywall to lurk and test stream quality
cons: No-frills layout looks dated next to Stripchat
Popular rooms move too fast for personal chat without big tips
Stream quality varies widely depending on each broadcaster's setup

facts.value: Launched 2011; operated by Multi Media LLC (California)
Open public rooms with optional paid tokens for tips and privates
Programmable room bots/apps and huge interactive Lovense toy adoption
